title: .ART Award on HUG – Winners Announced at Art Basel Miami Beach
location: Announcement at Art Basel Miami Beach, December 3, 2026
event_dates: Winners announced December 3, 2026 during Art Basel Miami Beach / Miami Art Week
deadline: Check current status on site (open as of late 2026; confirm on hug.art)
fee: Free (no fee; website is the application)
type: Prestigious award with announcement and prizes during Miami Art Week (may include visibility/exhibition elements)
what_they_looking_for: The process, practice, and story behind the artwork. Strong online presence / website.

application_questions: No traditional form. Your website (or HUG profile connected to free .ART domain) is the application. Minimal questions.

search_keywords: MIAMI .ART Award HUG Art Basel free prestigious Jerry Saltz

title: Kindred Spirit Outdoor Exhibition – MUCE Miami Art Week
location: Overtown, Miami (outdoor exhibition, Ninth Street Pedestrian Mall area)
deadline: Open / reviewing submissions (no hard public deadline listed; apply ASAP)
medium: Large-scale physical works preferred (4 ft x 4 ft or larger, ideally 8x8); painting, photography, mixed media
what_they_looking_for: Work exploring migration, adaptation, coexistence, people/animals/memory/land/culture/place. Theme of interconnected living world.
includes_entry: Yes – free public entry to the exhibition; selected artists exhibit outdoors during Miami Art Week
application_questions: Form fields include: artist bio, artist statement, image of work, availability for sale, availability for artist talks (dates), interest in programming beyond exhibition, how you heard about it.
receipts_required: Artist bio, artist statement, 1 image of the submitted work (large-scale preferred). Additional short answers on availability and sales.
search_keywords: MIAMI Kindred Spirit MUCE free outdoor exhibition Overtown
how_to_find_details: Google 'Kindred Spirit MUCE Miami Art Week' or visit muce305.org/kindred-spirit
notes: Free public outdoor exhibition during the week. Physical large-scale preferred. Community-focused, uplifting theme. Artists responsible for shipping/insurance. Good free opportunity for physical work.
